_hinweis: Bildprompts abgeleitet aus copy/bildbriefing.md. Der Stilblock haelt alle Bilder zusammen und wird vom Script an jeden Prompt angehaengt. Eintraege mit "aktiv": false laufen nicht mit, das sind verworfene Fassungen oder noch nicht freigegebene Motive. Aufruf: node scripts/gen-bilder-openai.mjs --only <kennung>
stilblock: Minimal 3D render, one single subject, nothing else in frame. Matte material, soft neutral studio light from one side, one soft shadow. Clean white background with a large amount of empty space around the object. Colour palette strictly limited to deep navy blue (#023047), amazon orange (#FF9900), white and light warm grey. No other colours, no gradients across the frame, no glow effects, no connecting lines, no floating icons, no collage of multiple symbols. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no interface labels. No people, no faces, no hands. No Amazon logo and no Amazon interface. Calm, restrained, editorial. High detail, quiet composition.

bilder.motiv: Geneigter Kartenstapel plus flach liegende Uhr: seit dem Launch nicht angefasst
bilder.prompt: A tall stack of identical plain light grey rounded cards on a clean surface, clearly tilted and leaning to one side, the edges slightly uneven as if the stack has been standing untouched for years. One single card near the top of the stack is amazon orange. In the foreground beside the stack, lying flat on its back, a plain deep navy blue round wall clock: a slim raised navy rim, a flat navy face, and two clearly readable pointed hands in amazon orange, one short and one long, no numbers and no tick marks on the dial. Exactly these two objects in the frame, generous empty space around them.
